user.title: Connect nextasks
user.description: Make a token in nextasks under My account → Connections. Pick the spaces Home Assistant may see, and "Read and write" if lists should be editable here.

data_description.url: The address you open nextasks with in the browser, without a path.
data_description.token: Starts with ntk_. nextasks shows it only once.

reauth_confirm.title: New token for {title}
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {url} no longer works: it ran out, or it was blocked or deleted. Make a new one for the same account under My account → Connections.

error.invalid_auth: nextasks does not know this token, or it ran out.
error.api_off: API tokens are switched off on this server. The operator switches them on under Settings → Server → API.
error.cannot_connect: nextasks cannot be reached at this address.
error.unknown: nextasks gave an answer that was not expected.

abort.already_configured: A token for the same account and the same spaces is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: This token belongs to another account. Make one for the account this connection was set up with.

data_description.shown_lists: Lists of spaces you hid in nextasks are not offered. New lists show up on their own.
data_description.completed_days: 0 shows no completed tasks. Removing completed tasks in Home Assistant moves them to the nextasks trash.

token_invalid.message: The nextasks token no longer works. Enter a new one.

api_off.message: API tokens are switched off on the nextasks server.

task_not_found.message: This task is no longer in the list.

not_loaded.message: This nextasks connection is not loaded.

create_task.name: Create task
create_task.description: Creates a task in a nextasks list, with the details a to-do list cannot carry.

list.name: List
list.description: The nextasks list the task goes to.

due_time.name: Due time
due_time.description: The time of day, in the account's time zone. Needs a due date.

flagged.name: Bookmark
flagged.description: Marks the task with a bookmark.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Words to find the task by.

url.name: Link
url.description: A web address that belongs to the task.
